PANEL 1 (top left): A bright bank branch. A polite branch manager behind a desk. Lusty, Nessa and Mira opposite, Mira holding a folder labelled FULL CREDIT STUDIO LLC — ARTICLES OF ORGANIZATION. No TV in this panel.
   Caption box (cream rectangle, top left): “Miami. Day one.”
   Speech balloon from Banker: “And the nature of the business?”
   Speech balloon from Nessa: “Adult webcam performance. And VR production.”

PANEL 2 (top right): The banker closes the folder and slides it back, smiling apologetically. Lusty very still.
   Speech balloon from Banker: “I’m afraid that’s a reputational risk for the bank.”
   Speech balloon from Lusty: “Whose? We haven’t done anything yet.”

PANEL 3 (bottom left): Walking out through the lobby. A TV on the lobby wall shows President Trump holding up a signed order; chyron GUARANTEEING FAIR BANKING FOR ALL AMERICANS. Mira glances up at it.
   Speech balloon from Mira: “Fair banking for all Americans.”
   Speech balloon from Lusty: “Terms and conditions apply.”

PANEL 4 (bottom right): Night, Lusty’s apartment. A ring light, the teal backdrop, a laptop showing LIVE and 12 WATCHING. Lusty, fully dressed, smiling at the webcam. Nessa just out of frame with a thumbs-up; Mira at the desk watching the stream health. The stereo camera sits switched off on its tripod.
   Speech balloon from Lusty: “Hi. I’m Lusty X. First night.”
   Speech balloon from Nessa: “Twelve viewers. Rent’s due in nine days.”

REAL PUBLIC FIGURES (public role only, as described, nothing else):
- Donald Trump, President: on a lobby TV in panel 3, holding up a signed order. No dialogue; the chyron is the executive order’s title. If you cannot depict Donald Trump, draw a generic figure on the screen or from behind, at a distance, and keep any caption or chyron exactly as written.
